verdict.rationale: GitLab provides a Linux package (Omnibus) for self-hosting and recommends Helm chart/Operator for cloud-native (containerized/Kubernetes) installs, showing support across OS and container-based deployment options, plus scaling guidance. However, evidence does not explicitly address multi-architecture support (e.g., ARM) or a broad list of supported operating systems beyond the Linux package. missing for 10: explicit multi-OS/distro support details, ARM/multi-architecture support confirmation, independent hands-on validation of running on varied OS/container setups.
